{{Top|leg}}
'''Mark One Pall of Smoke and Flame''' was a term used by [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to characterize one of the two ways a crashed StealthX could be found: the [[Flare stick|rescue beacon]] or the pall of smoke and flames that erupted after a crash-landing.
